# Authentic Morocco Adventures

> A Morocco-based tour operator running private, guided tours across Morocco:
> Sahara desert trips, cultural city excursions, and Atlas Mountains trekking.
> Based in Marrakech, Marrakech-Safi, Morocco.

Authentic Morocco Adventures organises private and small-group travel throughout
Morocco. Tours depart from Marrakech, Fes, Tangier, Casablanca and Agadir and
range from single-day excursions to multi-day itineraries crossing the Atlas
Mountains to the Sahara. All tours are guided by local Moroccan guides.

Contact: authenticmoroccoadventures@gmail.com | +212 666 107 312

## Main sections

- [Morocco Tours](https://www.authenticmoroccoadventures.com/tours): Multi-day
  and day tours, including Sahara desert routes from Marrakech, Fes and Tangier.
- [Activities](https://www.authenticmoroccoadventures.com/activities): Half-day
  and day experiences in and around Marrakech.
- [Trekking](https://www.authenticmoroccoadventures.com/trekking): Guided Atlas
  Mountains treks, including Mount Toubkal routes.
- [Destinations](https://www.authenticmoroccoadventures.com/locations): Travel
  guides for the cities and regions the tours visit.
- [Blog](https://www.authenticmoroccoadventures.com/blog): Morocco travel tips,
  seasonal guides and itinerary advice.
